content: #AvengersDoomsday #Avengers #Marvel AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY The end of an era begins. MovieTrailers Entertainment presents the "Redemption" TV Spot Concept for Marvel Studios' AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY, the next major event in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. A new threat is rising. The Avengers are assembling once again. And at the center of it all stands Doctor Doom. Directed by Anthony Russo and Joe Russo, Avengers: Doomsday brings together an unprecedented ensemble of Marvel characters from across the MCU, the X-Men universe, and The Fantastic Four. Robert Downey Jr. returns to the Marvel Cinematic Universe as Victor von Doom / Doctor Doom, leading one of the most anticipated chapters in the history of Marvel Studios. The cast includes Chris Hemsworth, Anthony Mackie, Sebastian Stan, Letitia Wright, Paul Rudd, Florence Pugh, Wyatt Russell, Tenoch Huerta Mejía, Simu Liu, Winston Duke, Danny Ramirez, Hannah John-Kamen, Lewis Pullman, David Harbour, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Vanessa Kirby, Joseph Quinn, Pedro Pascal, Chris Evans, Patrick Stewart, Ian McKellen, James Marsden, Alan Cumming, Rebecca Romijn, Kelsey Grammer and Channing Tatum, among others. DISCLAIMER: This is a concept tv spot created for entertainment and creative purposes by MovieTrailers Entertainment. All footage and audio elements are presented within a transformative creative work. The video features original editing, sound design, narrative reinterpretation, cinematic pacing and trailer construction created by MovieTrailers Entertainment.

chineseContent: #AvengersDoomsday #Avengers #Marvel AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY 一个时代的终结开始了。 MovieTrailers Entertainment 为漫威影业的《复仇者联盟：世界末日》展示了“救赎”电视广告概念，这是漫威电影宇宙的下一个重大事件。新的威胁正在崛起。复仇者联盟再次集结。而这一切的中心就是末日博士。 《复仇者联盟：世界末日》由安东尼·罗素和乔·罗素执导，史无前例地汇集了来自 MCU、X 战警宇宙和神奇四侠的漫威角色。小罗伯特·唐尼回归漫威电影宇宙，饰演维克多·冯·杜姆/毁灭博士，领导漫威影业历史上最受期待的篇章之一。演员包括克里斯·海姆斯沃斯、安东尼·麦凯、塞巴斯蒂安·斯坦、利蒂西亚·赖特、保罗·路德、弗洛伦斯·皮尤、怀亚特·拉塞尔、特诺奇·韦尔塔·梅吉亚、刘思慕、温斯顿·杜克、丹尼·拉米雷斯、汉娜·约翰-卡门、刘易斯·普尔曼、大卫·哈伯、埃邦·莫斯-巴克拉克、凡妮莎·柯比、约瑟夫·奎因、佩德罗·帕斯卡、克里斯·埃文斯、帕特里克·斯图尔特伊恩·麦克莱恩、詹姆斯·麦斯登、艾伦·卡明、丽贝卡·罗梅恩、凯尔希·格兰莫和查宁·塔图姆等。免责声明：这是 MovieTrailers Entertainment 出于娱乐和创意目的而制作的概念电视广告。所有素材和音频元素都在变革性的创意作品中呈现。该视频采用了由 MovieTrailers Entertainment 制作的原创剪辑、声音设计、叙事重新诠释、电影节奏和预告片制作。
